answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. The mechanism therefore aligns self-interest with network health: an attacker gains most by behaving honestly, because that is the only move that scales. Consider a whisper as the anchor of the cost.
